description: Portfolio of Mohamed Zahran, frontend engineer at RICOH Europe. Exposes profile, experience, projects, resume, and contact data to AI agents.

transport.description: Tools run in the browser via the WebMCP API (document.modelContext.registerTool). No network MCP endpoint is exposed; open the site in a WebMCP-capable browser to invoke the tools.

tools.name: get-profile
tools.description: Get Mohamed Zahran's professional profile: role, employer, location, summary, skills, and contact details.

tools.name: get-experience
tools.description: Get Mohamed Zahran's work experience history with highlights per role.

tools.name: list-projects
tools.description: List portfolio projects with descriptions, tech stacks, and links. Optionally filter by a keyword.

tools.name: get-resume
tools.description: Get the URL of Mohamed Zahran's resume PDF.

tools.name: get-contact
tools.description: Get contact details: email, phone, GitHub, LinkedIn, Instagram.
